item_verdicts.write_paths: Section 2 grants reckon/ledger.py and tests/test_hold_check_leaves_the_tree_clean.py; the diff from 47f356ab101cb46f57baabf0ae7933b5d47ff0a5 to a905942f135a7f439580f4a5d8a40a2e46be6e18 touches exactly those two plus the dispatch-declared evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-writes-only-what-it-owns/commit-every-file-a-hold-rewrote.html, and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_hold_check_leaves_the_tree_clean.py:209 and :242 assert an empty git status over the rewritten tree, which reddens the moment either caller stops staging the run file, and negative-control.log demonstrates that with two real mutations; only :241 (`assert returned > version`) is a weak monotonicity check that adds little beside them.
justifications.evidence: The gate that ran is the command the done_when names and its result is recorded, not claimed: head-arm.log opens with the revision, tree, imported module path and literal command and closes EXIT=0 on 6 passed, baseline-arm.log shows the same file 3 failed/3 passed at the base, and both declared mutations are applied in negative-control.log where each fails its own case.
justifications.fit: The change follows the module's own idiom (a private worker behind a public wrapper, docstrings in the surrounding voice, the existing _commit_state_write multi-path owner reused), carries no plan or ticket labels, and ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on both staged Python paths at a905942f13 under the repo's own configuration.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:2308 returns every rewritten path and both committing callers stage it (reckon/ledger.py:2296 and reckon/ledger.py:3654), which is exactly what the section's deliverable asks for, and the public write at reckon/ledger.py:2100 still returns an int so no caller outside the module changes.
justifications.reuse: Both mechanisms the change needed already had owners and were extended rather than duplicated: _commit_state_write (reckon/ledger.py:2506) already accepted a set of paths for one commit, and _keep_run_files_identical (reckon/ledger.py:1966) already returned the snapshots of every file re-encoded, so the addition feeds the existing owner instead of introducing a second writer.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the base-to-head diff (reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_hold_check_leaves_the_tree_clean.py, the evidence fragment) is one the dispatch declared, and the change carries nothing the goal does not imply except the corrected stale comment the plan itself asks for.
